MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

2. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

3. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.

4. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance.

6. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

8. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

9. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

10. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.
   C. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Singing Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
